Start **only AstrBot** on the home page. Keep **NapCat stopped** and do not use Start all.

The official **v2.2.1 ARM64 complete package** is about 50 MiB. **Copy the full block** to the Ubuntu terminal and run it. Any failure stops the remaining commands. Continue to step 3 after `Optional desktop startup profile saved.` appears.

① Tap **QQ desktop** to start QQ, open the desktop and **scan the sign-in code yourself**.

② Return here, tap **Start SnowLuma**, then **Open Web UI**. If the password is not filled in, **copy the initial password below** and paste it yourself. Review the terms, sign in and change the password.

**Token**: same as AstrBot. Save and enable.
**Verify a reply**: configure a model in AstrBot and send a message from **another QQ account**. Confirm a reply arrives. Keep NapCat stopped throughout.
Keep **AstrBot, QQ and SnowLuma running**, with **NapCat stopped**. You may return home or switch pages. Do not stop QQ or close the desktop.
